senses.gloss: m. (חָבַב) beloved, dear, precious; favored, privileged.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:10">Ab. II, 10</cite> <he>יהי … ח׳ עליך וכ׳</he> let thy neighbor’s honor be as dear to thee as thine own.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:14">Ib. III, 14</cite> <he>ח׳ אדם וכ׳</he> man is privileged (favored of God) in that he was created &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲבִיבִים</he>, <he>חֲבִיבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 5b:10">Ber. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ עליך וסורין</he> are sufferings dear to thee (as divine trials)?—
Yoma 52ᵃ ח׳ ישראל וכ׳ Israel is favored, for the Lord made them independent of a mediator; a. v. fr.—Fem. חֲבִיבָה.
<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 7:24">Tosef. Ber. VII, 24</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 63a:10">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. IX, end, 14ᵈ <he>ח׳ תורה וכ׳</he> the Law is appreciated.
<cite ref="Pesachim 68b:1">Pes. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה ח׳ מצוה בשעתה</he> how much more preferable is a religious act when done betimes; a. e.—Pl. <he>חֲבִיבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Sotah 13a:13">Sot. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>כמה ח׳ … על וכ׳</he> how dear were religious acts to Moses.
